scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Collection consists of theater, movie, and concert programs, mainly from Los Angeles and California, but also from New York, Boston, Chicago, and others from London, Europe, and Australia.

controlaccess.head: Indexing Terms
